# Monokai

Monokai applies a Monokai Pro-inspired dark palette to Obsidian for high-contrast notes and code. Anonymous Pro is configured for the interface and text and Victor Mono for monospace, and the recorded description names support for the DB Folder and Dataview plugins.

![Monokai screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bitschleuder/obsidian-monokai-theme/HEAD/assets/monokai-obsidian-theme-thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Monokai"
    author: "bitschleuder"
    repo:   "bitschleuder/obsidian-monokai-theme"
    slug:   "monokai"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/monokai"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/bitschleuder/obsidian-monokai-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bitschleuder/obsidian-monokai-theme/HEAD/assets/monokai-obsidian-theme-thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a Monokai Pro–inspired dark color palette to Obsidian for high-contrast, readable notes and code. Use configured Anonymous Pro for interface/text and Victor Mono for monospace, with support for DB Folder and Dataview plugins."
}
```
